shelter.notice.reset: We couldn't read your saved progress, so you're starting over.
tutorial.step1: Each number tells you how many angry cats are in the surrounding tiles. Look at the numbers on the edge: some touch just one hidden tile.
tutorial.step2: If a 1 touches just one hidden tile, there's a cat there. Choose Mark and mark both cats.
tutorial.step3: The 2 in the middle already has its two cats, so the rest is safe. Choose Reveal and open the remaining tiles.
tutorial.error: Meow! There was a cat there. Revealing a cat ends the board, but we'll forgive you this time.
tutorial.won.title: You rescued Hana!
tutorial.won.body: Hana can sniff out safe tiles. You also earned {n} cans to fix up the shelter.
